title: Staff awaiting a bonus
prompt: Return the names of staff who have not yet received a bonus (bonus is NULL).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE staff (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT, bonus REAL); INSERT INTO staff VALUES (1,'Nina','HR',500.0),(2,'Omar','HR',NULL),(3,'Priya','IT',1000.0),(4,'Quinn','IT',NULL),(5,'Ravi','Finance',750.0);
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM staff WHERE bonus IS NULL;
